programmes.d: Boy makes a turban; Dipsy, Po and Laalaa play; Tinky Winky goes for a walk.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number four. They have fun singing a song of four before it's time for Tubby Bye-Bye.
Becky goes on a tram ride and has an accident involving Po's scooter.
Laa-Laa comes through to door to say ‘eh-oh’, she joins the others to watch some children squeezing things. A squeezy tube appears in Teletubbyland.
The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the colour yellow. A magical new event happens in Teletubbyland – Little Bo Peep has lost her sheep, and doesn’t know where to find them.
The Teletubbies watch two girls climb a hill and look at the view. In Teletubbyland, Po looks for Tinky Winky. Over the hills, between the trees and along the path, but she couldn’t see him.
Tamzin Griffin pretends to be the Funny Lady; LaaLaa dances a secret dance.
Some Voice Trumpets rise to say Good Morning to the Teletubbies whilst they are eating Tubby Toast. They run off to see some children getting up in the morning.
Tinky Winky finds Po sleeping in his bed; Andy Brown looks for snails.
The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.
The Teletubbies learn about the number three just before three boats go sailing by.
Po falls off the slide then runs to watch some children stretching words with Stickman Laa-Laa is out for a walk when a voice trumpet rises and says a funny joke.
A voice trumpet sounds while the Teletubbies sleep; a lion and bear come to Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs.
Noo-Noo drives fast; children make a salad; dancing bear on the carousel.

Today in Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies are being quiet. A teddybear does a dance for the Teletubbies and the Teletubbies watch a little girl tap dancing. The Teletubbies go walking all around Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle.
Dipsy jumps indoors, the runs off to watch Annie and her dad land yachting on a beach. The Teletubbies sing 'Come Back Everything' song when a big wind blows their favourite things away.
Children learn about all things green; the Teletubbies pick Dipsy as their favorite green thing.
The Teletubbies dance around a tree. The Teletubbies and a group of children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty cloud.
The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue.
The Tubbies dance round a tree and then watch some children make a picture from pebbles. Tinky Winky has trouble making the Tubby Toaster work.

The Teletubbies are in Home Hill making loud footstep noises, but Tinky Winky has spilt Tubby Custard on his foot. Who should clean it up? A group of children go for a walk in the woods to play with the autumn leaves.
Natalie tells the Teletubbies about her brother's christening; magic cloud.

Po say's "Eh-oh" and runs off to join the other Tubbies when they watch Andy Brown and some children go on a boat trip to feed some sealions. The Tubbies are very busy at the switch panel, pressing buttons and pushing levers.
The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed.
The Teletubbies watch some children dancing while King Pleasure and the Biscuit Boys play 'See Saw Majory Daw'. Po has fun going up and down the slide. The Lion and Bear appear in Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies watch boys spin some special spinning tops to celebrate Hanukah.
The Teletubbies watch Andy Brown and some children visit some cygnets. In Teletubbyland, it's time for the Tubbies to go to bed, but Po is not tired, so she rides her scooter.
The Teletubbies dance; Yvette washes her plastic cups and saucers; messy day.
Some children have fun moving to Drum music. In Teletubbyland, all the Teletubbies are asleep, but then Tinky Winky sings a loud song.
The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets.

The Teletubbies join in with the game when a voice trumpet sings Humpty Dumpty. The magic windmill brings a musical transmission featuring King Pleasure and the Biscuit Boys. Po has a falling down day.
A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'.
The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song.
The Teletubbies watch a girl a called Rebecca, who shows us her dogs doing some tricks. A swing appears in Teletubbyland, and Laa-Laa plays on the swing.
The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards.
Laa-Laa wants to play indoors. She asks Po, Dipsy and Tinky Winky to play indoors too, but they want to play outdoors.
Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other.
The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies follow Tinky Winky's star all over Teletubbyland.
Teletubbies love dancing, but everything stops when the Teletubbies watch two boys play with their Mum's Keyboard.
A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme.
Laa-Laa has fun wearing Dipsy's hat. The Teletubbies watch Emily washing her pony, Jester. The Teletubbies enjoy playing a game washing with their Tubby sponges.
Children visit a level crossing and watch a train; animals march through Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies watch some children making bubbles. Magic things happen when Laa-Laa bounces her ball all over Teletubbyland.
Slide game; Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm; the lion and bear play hide-and-seek.
The Teletubbies meet to watch some children have great fun watering the garden. The Teletubbies play a hiding game.
The Teletubbies watch Oliver and his Llama. Po is feeling happy. She jumps and skips over Teletubbyland singing to herself.
Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep
Laa-Laa has no time for Tubby custard before watching some children make ice-lollies by freezing their favourite juice. The Teletubbies giggle as they all try to do everything together.
Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.
The Tubbies watch Andy Brown and some children look in a river for otters. Dipsy and Po play together.
Laa-Laa dances with her ball; living in a block of flats; balloon.

The Teletubbies watch Mark go for a ride on his pony Topus. Po goes on a journey; she says goodbye to Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa and sets off on her scooter. Po goes a long, long, long way before it is time for her to go home.
The Teletubbies imitate children doing funny walks before attempting funny walks of their own.
Some children play a game called oranges and lemons. A bell appears in Teletubbyland and makes a lovely ringing noise. The noise is so loud it makes the Tubbies fall over laughing
The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf.
The Teletubbies run up to see Debbie and some children singing some songs. A voice trumpet appears and plays a game with Po and Tinky Winky. It's called 'Two Little Teletubbies Sitting On A Hill."
Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

The Teletubbies have their favourite things, but where's Po's scooter? The Teletubbies and a group of children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty buzzy bee.
Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.
The Teletubbies watch some children dancing while King Pleasure and the Biscuit Boys play Hickory Dickory Dock. A voice trumpet appears and sings Hickory Dickory Dock.
Laa-Laa fetches the others to watch Brian Cant tell some children a story about a teddy bear called Cuddles. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po wonder where Laa-Laa is.
The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing...
Tinky Winky spills his Tubby Custard and the Noo-noo tidies it up. Tinky Winky joins the others to watch a little girl paint a Turkey using her hand as a template.
The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes.
The Teletubbies watch Andy Brown and some children go digging in the sand for worms. Laa-Laa and Po decide to share the scooter.
It's time for the Teletubbies to exercise; a voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch.

The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'. A pair of mittens appear in Teletubbyland and Tinky Winky does a special dance wearing them.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two.
The Teletubbies pop up from behind the hills to say “Eh-oh!” before watching three children and Andy Brown look in Rock pools for shrimps. Tinky Winky, Dipsy & Laa-Laa look for Po.
The animals march through Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies watch a little boy whose Dad is a firefighter. A beautiful fountain appears and Laa-Laa sings a fountain song. The fountain plays music like Laa-Laa’s song.
Amy cooks pasta at home; Noo-Noo cleans up an unraveled ball of string.
The Teletubbies watch Andy Brown and some children looking on a beach for Hermit Crabs. The Teletubbies love to play games. Today, they are playing a coming and going game.
Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker.
Another story about the Naughty Sock; the Tubby toast machine makes a pile of toast.
The Teletubbies watch two girls go ten pin bowling. Laa-Laa is playing with her ball. It begins to rain, so Laa-Laa plays with her ball indoors – not very carefully.
The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming.

The Teletubbies dance a twisty dance before watching Alex Pascall sing 'Little Baby'. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa decide to go for a walk, but Po is still asleep. They sing and clap their hands to try and wake up Po.
In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.
The Teletubbies are feeling tired. Andy Brown and a little girl look for spiders in a garden. Two voice trumpets rise and tell Tinky Winky the nursery rhyme 'Incy Wincy Spider'.
The Teletubbies love playing on the slide.
Andy Brown and two children watch a robin in the garden. The Teletubbies are 'Calling Out!' Laa-Laa calls to Dipsy who is very far away, then they call to Tinky Winky.
The Teletubbies learn gymnastic routines from Samira and her friends.
The Teletubbies laugh as they bump tummies. Then they watch some children play a body to body game. The Teletubbies love to play, they play a falling down game.
The number four with Noo Noo; Po draws an oval; black and white; a boy and a girl help milk a cow.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the colour orange. Laa-Laa loves her ball, she chases it all over Teletubbyland announcing to Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po that her ball is orange.
Maribel teaches flamenco dancing to two eager students; the Teletubbies wash their feet.
The Teletubbies watch two children take their dog for a walk. A voice trumpet appears and barks like a dog. Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po laugh as they run all over Teletubbyland barking.
The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.
The Teletubbies play a slide game before watching Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm. Then their mum cooks them for their tea.
Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.
The Teletubbies watch James help his mummy put his baby brother, Angus to bed. In Teletubbyland, Dipsy is asleep, so the other Teletubbies are being quiet.

The Teletubbies see three children at a Mandir Temple where they are celebrating the Diwali festival. The Teletubbies have a very busy day. They watch the clouds, smell the flowers, look for rabbits and run round the house, but they are still not tired.
Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies.
Tinky Winky brings the other Teletubbies out of the house to watch Andy Brown and two children look at caterpillars. A book appears in Teletubbyland and shows Po how to count to three.
The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo.

The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.
